newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Central Banking shrs up on purchase plan.
newsitem.headline: Central Banking shrs up on purchase plan.

text.p: Shares in South Korea's Central Banking Corp went limit-up in late Friday trading on news that Dong Kuk Steel Mill Co plans to buy 10 percent of Central's shares in the open market, brokers said.
Central was up 900 won to 12,200 at 0520 GMT.
"It is a big boost for the stock price... Unmatched buy orders are piling up," said Koh Kyung-bae of Hyundai Securities.
A total of 120,390 shares in Central Banking were traded.
Dong Kuk, which holds the largest single stake of 17.25 percent in Central Banking, said on Friday it would buy an additional 1.02 million Central shares to raise its stake in the group.
Dong Kuk said it would buy the shares over the next three months if Central Banking shareholders approve the plan. Central Banking shareholders are scheduled to meet on May 28.
